newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa govt abandons job equity project - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa govt abandons job equity project - paper.

text.p: The South African government's "Jobs for South Africa" project, in terms of which 11,000 affirmative action posts were advertised in the public service, has been abandoned with fewer than a quarter filled, Business Day said on Thursday.
The paper quoted Public Service Minister Zola Skweyiya as aying that because of problems in filling the posts and the "length of time it has been dragging", it had been decided to stop the project.
The initiative was launced shortly after the 1994 first all-race elections in an attempt to promote a more racially representative public service, the paper said.
